# 唔 + Verb / Adjective · *m4 + Verb / Adjective*

**Meaning:** not · **Level:** A1 · **Topic:** Negation

> ⚠️ **Draft — awaiting native-speaker review.** Spotted something unnatural? Please [report it](https://github.com/jyltsang/cantonlink-community/issues/new?template=content-error.yml&title=%5BCorrection%5D%20grammar%2Fm4-negation).

Put 唔 directly before a verb or adjective to negate it. The one big exception is 有 (to have): its negative is 冇, never 唔有.

**Written Chinese:** 不 — Written Chinese uses 不; in speech always say 唔.

## Examples

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **我唔食牛肉。** |
| Jyutping | ngo5 m4 sik6 ngau4 juk6. |
| Yale | ngóh m̀h sihk ngàuh yuhk. |
| Bopomofo | ㆭㄛ⁵ ㆬ⁴ ㄙㄧㆶ⁶ ㆭㄜㄨ⁴ ㄧㄨㆶ⁶. |
| English | I don't eat beef. |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **今日唔熱。** |
| Jyutping | gam1 jat6 m4 jit6. |
| Yale | gām yaht m̀h yiht. |
| Bopomofo | ㄍㄜㆬ¹ ㄧㄜㆵ⁶ ㆬ⁴ ㄧㆵ⁶. |
| English | It's not hot today. |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **佢唔係老師。** |
| Jyutping | keoi5 m4 hai6 lou5 si1. |
| Yale | kéuih m̀h haih lóuh sī. |
| Bopomofo | ㄎㆤㄧ⁵ ㆬ⁴ ㄏㄜㄧ⁶ ㄌㄛㄨ⁵ ㄙㄧ¹. |
| English | She isn't a teacher. |

## Common mistakes

- ✗ ~~我不去。~~ → ✓ **我唔去。** *ngo5 m4 heoi3.* · *ngóh m̀h heui.*  
  不 is written Chinese. Say 唔.
